newsitem.title: USA: Amway says global sales rise eight percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Amway says global sales rise eight percent in 1996.

text.p: Amway Corp said it achieved worldwide sales of $6.8 billion at estimated retail for the fiscal year ended August 31, 1996.
The company estimates retail as a blend of product costs to distributors and the markup of goods sold to the public.

The combined sales of the privately held Amway Corp and its publicly traded sister companies -- Amway Asia Pacific Ltd and Amway Japan Ltd -- represent a $500 million or eight percent increase over sales of $6.3 billion for fiscal 1995.
Fiscal year sales for Amway Asia Pacific will be released October 16 and for Amway Japan Ltd, on October 25.
Chairman Steve Van Andel said Amway "grew at a double-digit pace before the impact of foreign currency translation."

The company said growth was driven by strong sales worldwide of Amway's nutrition and wellness products and its Artistry cosmetic and skin care products, which posted increases of about 13 percent for each product line.
Sales of other Amway personal care products increased 10 percent. The direct-sales company employs more than 13,000 worldwide.
